strategy: Run heavy GPU workers sequentially on one 16 GB-class free GPU session. Keep API, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Piper TTS, procedural sound, FFmpeg, and storage on the main host.

models.name: Qwen3-8B-GGUF Q4_K_M
models.notes: Use non-thinking mode for schema-constrained production JSON. The Q4_K_M file is approximately 5 GB.

models.name: Stable Diffusion XL Base 1.0
models.notes: Generate reference sheets first, then keyframes. Use the approved character and workshop references for every downstream prompt.

models.name: IP-Adapter for SDXL
models.notes: Condition keyframes on the approved character reference images.

models.name: Stable Video Diffusion 1.1 Image-to-Video XT
models.notes: Generate short clips from approved keyframes. Review the model license and accept the gated repository terms before downloading.

models.name: Piper ar_JO-kareem-medium
models.license: Voice-specific MODEL_CARD plus Piper runtime license
models.runtime: CPU OpenAI-compatible wrapper included in workers/piper_compat
models.notes: Both demo characters use the same Arabic base voice with different speed and pitch processing.

models.name: MuseTalk
models.license: MIT code; project states trained models may be used commercially, subject to licenses of dependencies
models.notes: The demo uses stylized 3D human faces instead of flat drawings to improve face detection and mouth tracking.

models.name: Procedural Demo Sound Provider
models.notes: Creates original WAV ambience, effects, and simple score without third-party audio assets. Replace it later with a higher-quality licensed model.

required_user_secrets: HF_TOKEN for gated SDXL/SVD downloads after accepting their terms
private bearer tokens selected for LLM, TTS, lip-sync, and sound endpoints
test_acceptance: All provider health endpoints are green before their stage runs.
Every generated artifact is copied into permanent project storage.
Character clothing, face, workshop layout, and lantern design remain recognizable across all eight shots.
Every dialogue line has approved audio and a valid lip-sync segment.
Final QC passes video stream, audio stream, duration, peak, loudness, and subtitle bounds checks.
The final master, SRT, VTT, QC JSON, thumbnail, and at least one vertical short are produced.
